verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing says users can query the fleet in plain language and receive ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. That is a first-party natural-language-to-task-planning loop, separate from the job-assignment orchestration. However, the natural language is framed as asking what is happening, not as stating a task, and automatic execution after approval is only implied. missing for 10: documented natural-language task input (not just status queries), evidence that approved plans are executed automatically, technical docs or how-to for the feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can express a robot task in natural language and have the platform plan and execute it

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
